reviews.author: Nageh Hosny
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Noor Al Sabah Opticals. The staff were professional and friendly, the prices were reasonable, and the product quality was outstanding. reviews.author: Abdallah Alkhadam abdalgadier
reviews.text:
I recently visited Noor Alsabah and had, without a doubt, a perfect 5-star experience from start to finish. If you are looking for new glasses or exceptional eye care, this is the place to go.
The staff was incredibly welcoming, professional, and knowledgeable. They took the time to patiently guide me through the selection process, offering insightful recommendations without being pushy. They truly prioritized my comfort and ensured all my questions about lens options and insurance were answered clearly.  The selection of frames was excellent—they offered a fantastic mix of stylish, modern, and classic designs. My new glasses are absolutely perfect; the prescription is spot-on, and the quality of the lenses and frame is top-tier. I can tell the product is built to last.
I highly recommend Noor Alsabah. It’s rare to find a place where the customer service, product quality, and expertise are all this exceptional. Everything was, quite literally, perfect. Thank you, Noor Alsabah, for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.text: This is the only optical shop I have trusted in Sharjah for several years, and I just want to say thank you for the fast, easy, and smooth transaction. Overall, I am very happy with my new glasses and, for the record, this is already my fifth pair from Noor Opticals. Thank you again.
